svg.text: Figure 10-1 · The system requirements by function
The 39 system requirements of §2–§9, each with its type, its verification methods and two flags: 12 with a target still TBD, 14 with no test case yet
F-01 Lateral control (lane centring, assisted lane change)
While lateral control is active on a straight or curved road
inside the ODD, the system shall keep the vehicle near the
The commanded lateral acceleration shall not exceed 3.0
m/s² (roll-compensated) and the lateral jerk shall not exceed
The system shall follow curves down to the radius R_ODD =
v²/2.5 m/s² at the travel speed without saturating the
When the steering command saturates, the system shall warn
An assisted lane change shall start only after the driver
activates the turn signal and applies steering torque in the
An assisted lane change shall complete or be cancelled
within 10 s of the turn signal; it shall be cancelled when the
Lateral control shall not be active at standstill and shall
resume without a steering jump when the vehicle moves off.
Lateral control shall not cause oscillation (weaving) on a
The system shall hold the set speed within ±TBD km/h on
The set-speed range shall be the PCM cruise set range of
the reference vehicle, and shall not exceed the ODD speed
bound of 110 km/h (ODD-H, DQ-260; the arterial ODD-A was…
When following a lead, the system shall keep a time gap
equal to the selected personality: relaxed 1.75 s, standard
The default personality in the reference configuration shall
The system shall bring the vehicle to a stop behind a
stopping lead, keeping a stopped distance of about 6 m, and
After a standstill, the system shall resume automatically
when the lead moves off, within TBD s; without a lead, it
shall not move off without a driver action.
Comfort: in normal following, the commanded acceleration
shall stay within the cruise limits (1.6→0.6 m/s² by speed,
−1.2 m/s² cruise braking) and use stronger braking only for…
Experimental Mode (end-to-end longitudinal) shall be disabled
and not selectable in the reference configuration until
Engagement shall be possible only through the stock cruise
controls and only when no no-entry condition is present. In
the reference configuration a setting outside the assured…
The system shall refuse engagement, with a no-entry alert,
below the highway speed floor v_floor, and shall engage from
v_floor up to the ODD speed bound. This is the entry check…
A brake press or cancel shall disengage; the accelerator
shall override longitudinal control without disengaging
After start-up, the system shall be ready to engage within
Above 10 km/h, DM shall warn a visually distracted driver
with escalating alerts at 5, 8 and 13 s (vision policy) or 5,
DM classification performance shall meet AIR-07/AIR-08 of
DM shall work in the ODD lighting conditions (day, dusk,
night with IR) and with sunglasses, or fall back to the
On no response to the highest alert, the system shall slow
the vehicle, disengage and lock out re-engagement
The engaged/disengaged state shall be shown continuously
on the device and through the cluster cruise indicator and
An alert shall be displayed and its sound started within ≤
0.2 s of the event being raised by selfdrived.
Alert text shall describe the actual cause.
Alerts and sounds shall be perceivable at highway noise
F-06 / F-07 Forward collision warning and lane departure warning
FCW shall alert when the model predicts hard braking or the
FCW false alert rate shall be ≤ TBD per 1000 km.
LDW shall warn when not laterally engaged, above 31 mph,
with no turn signal in the last 5 s, when the vehicle drifts
In normal operation inside the ODD, the envelope shall not
reject any command produced by the SoC controller (no false
The envelope shall report its mode, parameter, authority
state, fault flags and counters to the SoC at ≥ 10 Hz.
F-09 Logging, upload, remote access, update
Every drive shall be logged in 60 s segments including CAN,
carControl, selfdriveState, pandaStates and model outputs.
Logs shall identify the software release, panda firmware
version and model artefacts in use.
Segments flagged by the driver shall be preserved from
Automatic deletion shall keep at least 5 GiB or 10 % of
Uploads, remote access and software updates shall be
configurable to the LionDriver policy and shall not run while
onroad unless the policy allows it.
With automatic updates disabled, the system shall not block
engagement because of missing update connectivity.
target TBD: the value is not set yet (OI-1)
no test case: no specified case verifies it (WP-S-09 OI-6)
Verification methods: A analysis · R review · T-SIL software test or process replay · T-HIL bench test · T-VEH vehicle test · LOG drive-log analysis · SIM simulation.

Generated by fig_s01_requirements.py from WP-S-01 §2–§9 and the coverage report of the SysML model; nothing is hand-listed. These are the non-safety requirements; the safety ones are the TSRs of WP-S-02.

g.text: Terms: ACC adaptive cruise control · AIR-nn AI safety requirement (WP-C-11 §6) · CAN controller area network: the vehicle's data bus · D-nn design decision of the earlier decision list (D-01…D-12; D-08 is the

Experimental Mode decision) · DM driver monitoring · DQ-nn decision of the project lead (decision register) · F-nn function of the item (WP-C-01 §2.1), F-01…F-09 · FCW forward collision warning · GiB gibibyte (2³⁰

bytes) · HMI human-machine interface: display, sounds, cluster · HUD head-up display (here the cluster's lane-assist display) · IR infrared · LDW lane departure warning · LKAS lane keeping assist system · LOG

verification by analysis of drive logs · ODD operational design domain: where the system is meant to work · ODD-H the claimed ODD: limited-access highways · OI-nn open item of the document it appears in · PCM

powertrain control module (engine and drive) · SIM verification by scenario simulation · SoC system on chip: the comma device's main processor, running openpilot (QM) · SYS system requirement SYS-nnn of WP-S-01 ·

SysML Systems Modeling Language: the system model in models/sysml · T-HIL verification by bench test with the real panda (hardware in the loop) · T-SIL verification by software test or process replay (WP-S-01 §1.1)

· T-VEH verification by vehicle test · TBD to be determined: a value not yet set · TSR-nn technical safety requirement (WP-S-02) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S
system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
